changelog_headings_2025_11_to_2026_10: ## October 2026
Network subnet type server is deprecated
Link headers are deprecated
Load Balancers can now be created with existing Primary IPs
Deleting a Load Balancer now returns an Action
Data Center endpoints return HTTP 410 Gone
## September 2026
Omitted TTL for changing an RRSet's TTL is not allowed
Omitted DNS pointers not allowed on change
Primary IP's assignee_type returns "unassigned" if IP is not assigned
New endpoint to list the resources attached to a Network
New requirements for deleting Buckets
Field "deprecated" will be removed
## August 2026
Debian 11 image is deprecated
Load Balancer health checks now report why a target is unhealthy
EC2-compatible routes for Server Metadata were removed
## July 2026
OpenSUSE 15 image is unavailable for new servers
Omitted TTL for changing an RRSet's TTL is deprecated
Omitted DNS pointers deprecated on change
Remove Datacenters properties for Primary IPs and Servers
## June 2026
Fedora 42 image is unavailable for new servers
EC2-compatible routes for Server Metadata are deprecated
Load Balancer Idle Timeout now configurable via the Console
Field "deprecated" on Load Balancer Types is now deprecated
Deprecation Info for Load Balancer Types
Deprecation Data Center endpoints
Private Networks auto-configuration is available via cloud-init
Fedora 44 and Ubuntu 26.04 are now available
Deleting assigned Primary IPs & Floating IPs is no longer possible
## April 2026
OpenSUSE 15 image is deprecated
Load Balancers idle timeout can now be configured
All GET /<resource>/{id}/actions/{action_id} operations are deprecated
Primary IP's assignee_type will return "unassigned" if IP is not assigned
Primary IP's Create property "assignee_type" is now optional
Leading whitespace characters in SSH Keys are invalid
